entities.name: Auron
entities.description: A character who urges others to choose and shape their own stories and fate.

entities.name: Ashelia B'nargin Dalmasca
entities.description: Princess of Dalmasca who questions whether her duty is to destroy the Empire, and wants only to be free.

entities.name: Galuf Baldesion
entities.description: A warrior who travels toward North Mountain and vows to destroy Exdeath even at the cost of his life.

entities.name: Exdeath
entities.description: A villainous warlock who threatens to return all existence to nothing.

entities.name: Locke Cole
entities.description: A fighter who thanks the moogles for their help and vows to keep fighting to protect people.

entities.name: Noctis Lucis Caelum
entities.description: Prince of Lucis who calls on the Kings of Lucis and leaves home behind at King Regis's urging.

entities.name: Regis
entities.description: King who asks Noctis whether he is ready to leave home behind.

entities.name: Insomnia
entities.description: The Crown City, home that Noctis leaves behind.

entities.name: Lucis
entities.description: The kingdom of which Noctis is prince.

entities.name: Ignis Scientia
entities.description: A companion who suggests learning to cook one's catch.

entities.name: Gaius van Baelsar
entities.description: A figure horrified by the devastation of Ultima, which he did not intend.

entities.name: Garnet
entities.description: Princess of Alexandria who will someday be queen but always herself.

entities.name: Lulu
entities.description: A character who offers guidance to the clueless.

entities.name: Alisaie Leveilleur
entities.description: A young woman who bids farewell to her grandfather Louisoix after his sacrifice.

entities.name: Louisoix
entities.description: Alisaie Leveilleur's grandfather, who made a sacrifice.

entities.name: Cloud Strife
entities.description: A fighter who advises Barret in battle and refuses to give up.

entities.name: Barret Wallace
entities.description: A fighter who hears the planet crying out in pain.

entities.name: Sephiroth
entities.description: An ominous figure who warns Cloud about fate and declares the end for all.

entities.name: Bartz Klauser
entities.description: A traveler who wanders with his chocobo, feeling the wind calling him.

entities.name: Aria Benett
entities.description: A woman who prays for the crystal of water to regain its light.

entities.name: Kuja
entities.description: A sorcerer who calls the black mages dark spawn of the mist and craves power.

entities.name: Wakka
entities.description: A blitzball player who gave someone a sword.

entities.name: Yuna
entities.description: A woman whose journey ends at Zanarkand and who vows to stand her ground.

entities.name: Zanarkand
entities.description: A city dead for a thousand years, the end of Yuna's journey.

entities.name: Baku
entities.description: Leader of Tantalus, whose airship crashed in a forest.

entities.name: Tantalus
entities.description: A band led by Baku that includes the thief Marcus.

entities.name: Marcus
entities.description: A Tantalus thief who describes Treno.

entities.name: Quistis Trepe
entities.description: A character who advises that sometimes it's better to run.

entities.name: Terra
entities.description: A girl named by the esper Maduin.

entities.name: Maduin
entities.description: An esper who chose the name Terra for her.

entities.name: Tifa Lockhart
entities.description: A fighter who says goodbye to Midgar.

entities.name: Midgar
entities.description: A city that is a triumph of technology and testament to man's potential.

entities.name: Rydia
entities.description: A summoner of mist who helps someone move again.

entities.name: Sazh Katzroy
entities.description: A man whose chocobo chick has no name.

entities.name: Clive Rosfield
entities.description: A man who thanks his hound Torgal for never giving up.

entities.name: Torgal
entities.description: Clive Rosfield's faithful hound.

entities.name: Zell Dincht
entities.description: A fist-fighter who explains the Crystal Pillar inside the Lunatic Pandora.

entities.name: Lunatic Pandora
entities.description: A structure containing a Crystal Pillar that calls monsters from the Moon.

entities.name: Crystal Pillar
entities.description: A thing inside the Lunatic Pandora that calls monsters from the Moon.

entities.name: Kefka
entities.description: A destroyer who used his Light of Judgment to torch Mobliz and vows to destroy life, dreams and hope.

entities.name: Light of Judgment
entities.description: Kefka's destructive power, used to torch Mobliz.

entities.name: Mobliz
entities.description: A village far to the east torched by Kefka.

entities.name: Banon
entities.description: Leader of the Returners, who warns against the Empire's Magitek arsenal.

entities.name: Returners
entities.description: A group led by Banon opposing the Empire.

entities.name: Minfilia Warde
entities.description: A woman who speaks of the Sharlayans' wisdom.

entities.name: Sharlayans
entities.description: Keepers of wisdom whose mastery of magic and aether was unsurpassed.

entities.name: Garleans
entities.description: A people who feared the Sharlayans.

entities.name: Raubahn Aldynn
entities.description: A warrior who proclaims a new day in Eorzea.

entities.name: Eorzea
entities.description: A realm to which the elder primal Odin has returned.

entities.name: Odin
entities.description: An elder primal who has returned to Eorzea.

entities.name: Ultimecia
entities.description: A fearful sorceress whose heart is filled with anger and hate, opposing the SeeDs.

entities.name: Edea Kramer
entities.description: A woman who describes Ultimecia.

entities.name: SeeDs
entities.description: Warriors whose crusade Ultimecia vows to end.

entities.name: Lightning
entities.description: A woman who took the name Lightning to be strong for Serah.

entities.name: Serah Farron
entities.description: A woman for whom Lightning had to be strong.

entities.name: Fang
entities.description: A l'Cie desperate to figure out her Focus to save Vanille.

entities.name: Vanille
entities.description: Fang's companion, at risk of becoming a Cie'th.

entities.name: Cocoon
entities.description: A world whose capital is Eden.

entities.name: Eden
entities.description: Cocoon's capital, sharing its name with its fal'Cie patron.

entities.name: Ishgard
entities.description: A great and proud nation devoted to Halone.

entities.name: Halone
entities.description: The Fury, to whom Ishgard is devoted.

entities.name: Guado
entities.description: A people who protect the Farplane.

entities.name: Farplane
entities.description: Where the dead rest in peace, protected by the Guado.

entities.name: Windurst
entities.description: A nation led to glory by the first Star Sibyl.

entities.name: Star Sibyl
entities.description: The first Star Sibyl gained the powers of the stars and moon at Full Moon Fountain.

entities.name: Gabranth
entities.description: A Judge Magister who claims to have slain a king and a country.

entities.name: Ascians
entities.description: Enemies defeated thanks to a woman's sacrifice.

entities.name: Warriors of Light
entities.description: Four warriors foretold to come when darkness veils the world and restore hope.

entities.name: Seventh Astral Era
entities.description: A new era proclaimed as come.

events.summary: Alisaie Leveilleur bids farewell to her grandfather Louisoix after his sacrifice.
events.quote: Pray take your rest, Grandfather... You deserve it.

events.summary: A Tzen resident recalls Kefka using his Light of Judgment to torch the village of Mobliz.
events.quote: I saw when Kefka used his Light of Judgment to torch the village of Mobliz, far to the east.

events.summary: Tantalus's airship crashes in a forest.
events.quote: Just our luck to crash in this forest... it's gonna get interesting...

events.summary: The esper Maduin chooses the name Terra for her.
events.quote: I've chosen a name for her . . . Terra.

events.summary: Galuf vows to destroy Exdeath even if he must take him into the afterlife himself.
events.quote: I'll destroy you Exdeath... even if it means I have to take you into the afterlife myself!

events.summary: Tifa Lockhart says goodbye to Midgar.
events.quote: Guess this is goodbye, City of Mako.

events.summary: King Regis asks Noctis if he is ready to leave home behind, and Noctis says he is.
events.quote: I need only know that you are ready to leave home behind," said King Regis.

events.summary: The elder primal Odin returns to Eorzea.
events.quote: The elder primal Odin has returned to Eorzea.

events.summary: Lightning recalls forgetting her past and becoming Lightning to be strong for Serah.
events.quote: I had to be strong for Serah, so I thought I needed to forget my past. And I became Lightning.

events.summary: Gabranth declares he slew a king and a country.
events.quote: I slew your king. I slew your country.
